selection_rationale.scope-guardian-reviewer: two multi-requirement deliverables and four consumers
selection_rationale.security-lens-reviewer: standalone SSE endpoints with no auth model
selection_rationale.adversarial-document-reviewer: new shared abstractions, external integration, and unresolved alternatives

findings.title: Prerequisite sequencing conflicts
findings.why_it_matters: It is unclear whether P/Q are hard gates or may be retrofitted after spike work starts, changing 1c sequencing.
findings.suggested_fix: Choose one sequencing policy and align the Key Decision and 1c assumption.
evidence: both must land before any spike can be implemented
if 1c starts before P/Q reconciliation becomes a refactor

findings.title: Q9 baseline conflicts with reconciliation
findings.why_it_matters: Q9 mandates a standalone reference before spikes while later text suggests implemented 1c can be the primary reference.
findings.suggested_fix: Decide whether Q9 always requires a standalone source or allows implemented 1c.
evidence: Q9 says before any spike exists
Outstanding Questions says 1c can be intended primary reference

findings.title: Envelope lacks generation and page identity
findings.why_it_matters: P cannot implement generation-scoped watermarks, page ledgers, or atomic promotion from its specified envelope alone.
findings.suggested_fix: Define a versioned control-plane API carrying generation, page/batch completion, and promotion information.
evidence: P9 requires staging generation, promotion, pending ledger and generation-scoped watermarks

deferred_questions: Which typed control-plane representation carries generation, page/batch completion and promotion?

findings.title: Keep 1c-specific replay machinery out of P baseline
findings.why_it_matters: A four-spike prerequisite becomes a one-consumer Data Sync state machine and delays spikes that do not need that lifecycle model.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the common P contract prerequisite and move 1c fencing/ledger to an optional compatible extension.
evidence: P is a small reusable library for all four spikes
P9 requires staging generation and per-page ledger because 1c is the advanced consumer

residual_risks: A deliberate shared-baseline/1c-extension boundary is still needed.
deferred_questions: Should the 1c ledger be an adapter package or optional extension?

findings.title: Constrain comparator stream exposure
findings.why_it_matters: An unauthenticated standalone harness can expose message/user snapshots to machines on the network.
findings.suggested_fix: Require loopback binding and test data for standalone topology; exclude remote listening without a future auth model.
evidence: Q2 specifies POST and GET stream endpoints
Scope excludes production hardening and auth model

findings.title: Shared APIs lack real-consumer validation gate
findings.why_it_matters: Self-tests may pass while the first real consumer requires bespoke adaptation, defeating build-once reuse.
findings.suggested_fix: Require contract-testing or integration of 1c U4/U6 before P/Q interfaces are stable; label them provisional first.
evidence: Q9 permits minimal source before consumers
P9 should be validated against 1c before 1c starts

residual_risks: Sibling checkout availability and unimplemented 1c shape can change before extraction.
deferred_questions: Must P/Q pass actual 1c integration before their APIs are stable?

findings.title: Envelope lacks generation and page identity

findings.recommendation: Split shared baseline from compatible 1c extension.

findings.title: Shared APIs lack real-consumer validation gate
findings.recommendation: Validate the provisional APIs through 1c U4/U6 before stable status.
